006package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic;
007
008import java.time.temporal.TemporalAmount;
009
010import dev.metaschema.core.datatype.adapter.AbstractDurationAdapter;
011import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.InvalidValueForCastFunctionException;
012import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.type.IAtomicOrUnionType;
013import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.type.InvalidTypeMetapathException;
014import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.type.impl.TypeConstants;
015import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
016
017/**
018 * An atomic Metapath item representing a duration data value.
019 * <p>
020 * This interface supports both day-time and year-month duration formats
021 * following the ISO 8601 standard. Examples of valid durations include:
022 * <ul>
023 * <li>P1Y2M (1 year, 2 months)
024 * <li>P3DT4H5M (3 days, 4 hours, 5 minutes)
025 * </ul>
026 *
027 * @see IDayTimeDurationItem
028 * @see IYearMonthDurationItem
029 */
030public interface IDurationItem extends IAnyAtomicItem {
031  /**
032   * Get the type information for this item.
033   *
034   * @return the type information
035   */
036  @NonNull
037  static IAtomicOrUnionType<IDurationItem> type() {
038    return TypeConstants.DURATION_TYPE;
039  }
040
041  /**
042   * Construct a new duration item using the provided string {@code value}.
043   *
044   * @param value
045   *          a string representing a day time duration
046   * @return the new item
047   * @throws InvalidTypeMetapathException
048   *           if the provided string value is not a year/month or day/time
049   *           duration value according to ISO 8601
050   */
051  @NonNull
052  static IDurationItem valueOf(@NonNull String value) {
053    try {
054      return AbstractDurationAdapter.parseDuration(value);
055    } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
056      throw new InvalidTypeMetapathException(
057          null,
058          String.format("Invalid year/month or day/time duration value '%s'.",
059              value),
060          ex);
061    }
062  }
063
064  /**
065   * Cast the provided type to this item type.
066   *
067   * @param item
068   *          the item to cast
069   * @return the original item if it is already this type, otherwise a new item
070   *         cast to this type
071   * @throws InvalidValueForCastFunctionException
072   *           if the provided {@code item} cannot be cast to this type
073   */
074  @NonNull
075  static IDurationItem cast(@NonNull IAnyAtomicItem item) {
076    IDurationItem retval;
077    if (item instanceof IDurationItem) {
078      retval = (IDurationItem) item;
079    } else {
080      String value;
081      try {
082        value = item.asString();
083      } catch (IllegalStateException ex) {
084        // asString can throw IllegalStateException exception
085        throw new InvalidValueForCastFunctionException(ex);
086      }
087
088      try {
089        retval = valueOf(value);
090      } catch (InvalidTypeMetapathException ex) {
091        throw new InvalidValueForCastFunctionException(
092            String.format("Value '%s' cannot be parsed as either a day-time or year-month duration", value),
093            ex);
094      }
095    }
096    return retval;
097  }
098
099  @Override
100  TemporalAmount getValue();
101
102  @Override
103  default IDurationItem castAsType(IAnyAtomicItem item) {
104    return cast(item);
105  }
106
107  /**
108   * Compares this value with the argument.
109   *
110   * @param item
111   *          the item to compare with this value
112   * @return a negative integer, zero, or a positive integer if this value is less
113   *         than, equal to, or greater than the {@code item}.
114   */
115  int compareTo(@NonNull IDurationItem item);
116}
